summary.text: Heather Bagnall is a Democratic member of the Maryland House of Delegates representing District 33C and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Republican Kristin Norris.
She chairs the House Health Committee and also serves on the Rules and Executive Nominations Committee.

paragraphs.text: Bagnall was born in Washington, D.C., graduated from Broadneck Senior High School in 1992 and earned a B.S. in theater performance from Towson University in 1996.
She also completed additional studies at Wagner College and the Second City in Chicago.

Her career includes work as an arts educator and administrator, assistant director at the Holton-Arms Creative Summer, playwright, entertainment cruise staff for the Disney Cruise Line, co-founding artistic director of Tasty Monster Productions and Encores TheARTricals, and editor at Fringe Review.
Ballotpedia lists Bagnall's tenure in the House of Delegates as beginning in 2019.
She won re-election in District 33C on November 8, 2022, defeating Republican Kerry Gillespie, 54.1% to 45.8%.
She advanced from the June 23, 2026 Democratic primary unopposed.
In a 2018 Ballotpedia survey, Bagnall said her top three priorities were education, the environment and community infrastructure.
